title: File must be valid JSON in the CMS template shape
cite: 45 CFR 180.50(c); CMS machine-readable file template v2.2.0
fix: Publish the CMS JSON schema shape - a top-level object, not an array, log or CSV export.

title: Required top-level fields are missing
cite: 45 CFR 180.50(b)(1); CMS template v2.2.0 data dictionary
fix: Add hospital_name, last_updated_on, version, hospital_location, hospital_address and license_information at the top level.

title: version must name the CMS template version
fix: Set version to the CMS template version you built against, for example 2.2.0.

title: last_updated_on must be YYYY-MM-DD
cite: CMS template v2.2.0 data dictionary, last_updated_on
fix: Write the date as 2026-01-31, not 01/31/2026 or a free-text month.

title: The file has not been updated in the last 12 months
fix: Republish with a current last_updated_on before the twelve months run out.

title: Affirmation block missing or not confirmed
fix: Add the affirmation statement and set confirm_affirmation to the boolean true, not the string "true".

title: standard_charge_information is missing, empty, or an item has no description or code
fix: Every item needs a plain-language description and at least one code with its code type.

title: Unrecognised code type
cite: CMS template v2.2.0, code_information.type value list
fix: Use a CMS-listed type: CPT, HCPCS, ICD, DRG, MS-DRG, APR-DRG, APC, NDC, HIPPS, LOCAL, EAPG, CDT, RC, TRIS-DRG.

title: setting must be inpatient, outpatient, or both
fix: Set setting to one of inpatient, outpatient, both - lower case, no other wording.

title: Gross charge or discounted cash price missing for an item
fix: Publish gross_charge and discounted_cash for every item you charge for; leave neither to the payer rows.

title: A percentage or algorithm rate is published with no estimated_amount
fix: When the negotiated rate is a percentage or an algorithm, also publish an estimated allowed dollar amount.

title: Methodology missing, unlisted, or "other" with no note
fix: Use case rate, fee schedule, percent of total billed charges, per diem, or other - and when it is other, fill additional_payer_notes.

title: A dollar amount is published as a string
cite: CMS template v2.2.0 - charge fields are numbers
fix: Write 1234.00 as a JSON number, without quotes, so the CMS validator can read it.

title: Placeholder or dummy charge value
cite: 45 CFR 180.50(b)(2) - charges must be the hospital's actual prices
fix: Replace 0, 9999999, N/A and "call for price" with the real dollar amount or drop the row.

title: Drug item without unit and type of measurement
fix: Give drug_information both a unit number and a type such as ML, GR, or UN.
